object:lance.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a long slim dark lance angled upward, with a pale triangular hand guard near the base. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:lance.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the lance as a riding weapon used for mounted combat.
object:lance.modelBrief: Build a long tapering metal lance with a distinct hand guard and dark grip. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:mace.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a brown handle with a dark round blue-gray mace head pierced by a pale center. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:mace.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the mace as a one-handed iron bludgeoning weapon.
object:mace.modelBrief: Build a short brown haft and round socketed metal striking head. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:silver mace.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a brown handle topped by a pale silver mace head with dark central opening. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:silver mace.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the silver mace as a one-handed bludgeoning weapon made of silver.
object:silver mace.modelBrief: Build a mace matching tile 862 but with a bright silver head and cool highlights. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:morning star.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a brown shaft holding a large dark jagged ball with several blunt spikes. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:morning star.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the morning star as a one-handed iron morning star.
object:morning star.modelBrief: Build a spiked dark iron striking head on a sturdy wooden haft. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:war hammer.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a brown haft beneath a dark cross-shaped hammer head with a pale glint. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:war hammer.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the war hammer as a one-handed iron hammer.
object:war hammer.modelBrief: Build a compact metal hammer head with opposing striking ends and brown handle. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:club.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick tapered reddish-brown club with a narrow tan grip. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:club.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the club as a one-handed wooden club.
object:club.modelBrief: Build a simple heavy wooden cudgel with broad dark upper end and pale hand grip. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:rubber hose.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a bright red flexible hose curling twice in a loose S shape. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:rubber hose.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the rubber hose as a one-handed plastic whip-class weapon.
object:rubber hose.modelBrief: Build a soft red tube coiled into two open loops, with rounded ends and no metal tip. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:staff / quarterstaff.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a straight gold-brown staff running diagonally with darker ends. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:staff / quarterstaff.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the quarterstaff as a two-handed wooden quarterstaff. This tile shows the staff appearance associated with that item.
object:staff / quarterstaff.modelBrief: Build one plain long wooden rod with subtle darker end caps and no magic ornament. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:thonged club / aklys.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark gray club head and brown grip attached to a looping reddish thong. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:thonged club / aklys.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the aklys as an iron thonged club. This tile shows the thonged club appearance associated with that item.
object:thonged club / aklys.modelBrief: Build a compact weighted club with its visible leather thong loop kept distinct from the shaft. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:flail.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a brown handle connected by a short dark chain to a dark hanging striking head. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:flail.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the flail as a one-handed flail weapon.
object:flail.modelBrief: Build a wood grip, short articulated chain, and separate weighted head with open space between parts. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:bullwhip.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a coiled blue-gray lash beside a short tan-brown handle. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:bullwhip.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the bullwhip as a one-handed whip made of leather.
object:bullwhip.modelBrief: Build a narrow flexible whip in a loose open coil with a small wooden-colored grip. Keep the main shape and palette readable at 32-pixel size.

object:bow.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a narrow ochre curved bow standing upright with a pale straight string. The blue-gray floor pattern is background.
object:bow.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the bow as a wooden launcher for arrows.
